About: Applications install-apps.ps1 can install. Key = the name used in -Apps / client.json Apps. Url = vendor's MSI over https. Signer = O= of the MSI's Authenticode signing certificate; the install is refused unless the signature is Valid and names it. Sha256 = for a vendor that doesn't sign its MSI: the exact file's SHA-256, so Url must point at that one pinned version; the install is refused unless the download matches. Every entry needs Signer, Sha256 or both. Pinned (Sha256) entries change only by editing Url + Sha256 and releasing, and install-apps doesn't upgrade an existing install. Match = wildcard on the DisplayName of the machine-wide uninstall entry, used to detect an existing install. Name = display only.
